## Learning goals

Complete the exercises below using `fpp3`. Show plots and short written interpretations.

## Setup

```{r}
library(fpp3)
```


## 1. Levels vs growth

```{r}
spain <- global_economy |> filter(Country == "Spain")
spain |> autoplot(log(GDP))
spain |> mutate(g = difference(log(GDP))) |> autoplot(g)
```

## 2. ACF comparison

```{r}
spain |> ACF(log(GDP)) |> autoplot()
spain |> ACF(difference(log(GDP))) |> autoplot()
```

## 3. Hand check

Verify `difference()` on a short numeric vector matches $\nabla y_t$ by hand.
